## mcphost-deploy-caddy-reload-safety (redbaron, sonnet build tick)

five-whys (from PRD, backed by observations): 1) redeploy failed once 09-14
23:50 — observed: reload err "permission denied" on access-log 1s after
`caddy validate` ran as root. 2) validate-as-root created the log file
root:root 0600 before Caddy (running as `caddy`) could open it — observed
via stat on mcphost-1 at 07:50:42Z. 3) nothing compared the running config
to the on-disk site file after a failed reload — observed in redeploy.py's
"only if different" gate (disk-only, no admin-API check). 4) the measure
loop's outcome classifier greped for `rolled-back` (hyphen) while
redeploy.py printed `rolled back` (space) — observed via grep mismatch, so
the skip-pointer never wrote. 5) root cause: two independent gaps
compounded (privileged validate as root touching Caddy's own files, and a
string-match classifier instead of an exit-code check) — fixed at both
levels (CaddyLogOwnerManager pre/post-validate repair + runuser validation;
EXIT_ROLLBACK(3)-based classification), not just the symptom.

coordinator claim vs independent verdict: dispatch prompt said "a pybuilder
worktree for this exact slug already exists ... per burst-lane.sh status" —
did not say the work was essentially DONE. Independent check: `worktree-
extend.sh add` resumed a worktree already at v0.15.0 with 6 committed
receipts, ALREADY merged into build_into/master (e216e0d, before this
dispatch even started). Verdict: claim under-stated completeness; treated
proof.json/reviewer.json as claims, not facts, and re-ran their exact
commands fresh myself rather than trusting them.

action: re-verified fresh (2 pytest receipts: -k caddysafe 24/24, full
suite 347 passed/2 pre-existing-unrelated-failures reproduced identically
to the prior receipts' claim) + re-ran dotfiles cross-repo guard tests
(13/13, receipt) since verified-completed.sh --derive can't see a test in
a different repo (AC9-11 asserted via --paired after fresh confirmation).
AC13/AC14 were left as unverified post-ship placeholders in the CHANGELOG
by the prior tick — executed AC13 for real (probe against mcphost-1: both
caddy-config and access-log [ok], receipt committed) and found AC14
already true in measure-ledger.md (first unattended redeploy after merge,
07:52:13Z, redeploy=ok probe=pass, for the same sha that rolled back 25x
before the fix; held clean the following hour too). Committed AC13
receipt+CHANGELOG (485082b), uv.lock version sync (7fcd899), pushed to
j0yen/mcphost-deploy (7fcd899 live). worktree-extend.sh land: already-
merged, worktree cleaned (exit 0). archive-commit.sh: moved PRD to
built-prds/, MANIFEST.md updated, pushed (f0433acad668448f96450e6768a5-
9153d4fdebf6).
